heading: Is Dumpling-filling gluten free?
intro: This public analysis report explains the biggest gluten risks in Dumpling-filling and how to order more safely.

verdict.summary: Dumpling fillings can pose a gluten risk primarily due to the use of wheat-based ingredients and cross-contamination during preparation. Care should be taken to ensure that gluten-free ingredients are used and that there is no cross-contact with gluten-containing foods.

disclaimer: This guidance is informational only. Always verify ingredients and preparation with the restaurant.
